title: Base-retarget dismissal promises a review after opt-out
problem: For a base retarget, action equals edited, so line 887 skips the new opt-out message. The earlier path dismisses with "Stamphog re-reviews automatically." The carve-out then reports opted_out and queues no review. The GitHub message promises work that will not run.
suggestion: Resolve the inbox carve-out before the base-retarget dismissal. Pass an opt-out message when no review will run. Only use the automatic-review message when the code will queue a replacement run.
cluster_issue: Opt-out dismissal copy/log mismatch on a base-retarget delivery (retarget message posted while log says inbox_opt_out)
